spec.Business source and objective: BRD ch09; Match verified payments and invoices and report commercial closure readiness
spec.Trigger / required supplied input: Authorized business event or manual import; signed webhook if applicable; Invoice and authorized receipt source
spec.Result / acceptance: Invoice/payment evidence; acceptance: SM-SVC-21-WF01-TC-POS and step tests (ch33)
spec.Proposed domain contract: receivable payload schema SM-SVC-21-WF01@2; fields below; source-specific mandatory fields validated against required input; nullable non-applicable fields only.

spec.Engine / agent: Transaction reconciliation; Workflow orchestration; Governance; Financial review; anomaly explanation
spec.Workflow KPI (proposed): reference match precision; duplicate receipt count; baseline and threshold approved in pilot; source service KPI Duplicate allocations = 0; reconciled payment or exception 100%

spec.Proposed contract mapping: API-V2-RUN / API-V2-RESULT / API-V2-APPROVAL; DB-V2-RUN, STEP, ARTIFACT, EVIDENCE, EFFECT; domain receivable. Existing specialized operations must be retained or mapped by reviewed adapter; not a deployed endpoint.
spec.Cost source: Illustrative internal INR 0.15/invocation; excludes provider/retry/labor and other fees.
spec.Preconditions: Active entitlement, correct tenant/startup, valid inputs and approved policy; provider stub/synthetic fixtures; live entitlement, consent, source rights, policy, budget, scoped object refs
spec.Failure handling: Bounded retry for safe failures; reconcile uncertain external outcome before retry; pause, route reviewer and log; emergency stop; no external effect without authorization; ambiguous effect RECONCILING

csv.Sub-automation name: SM-SVC-21-WF04 — Receivable anomaly and overdue payment-risk monitoring
csv.Business objective: Match verified payments and invoices and report commercial closure readiness
csv.Detailed functionality: Reconcile amounts; flag anomalies; calculate overdue exposure; route review
csv.Applicable industries: Businesses with verified invoices, payments or receivables
csv.Supported channels: Private financial workspace
csv.Trigger types: Manual; scheduled or relevant validated business event; provider webhook only where authorized
csv.Required input data: Invoices, verified payments, due dates and currency
csv.Workflow steps: Reconcile amounts; flag anomalies; calculate overdue exposure; route review
csv.Prerequisite automations: Included foundation; no mandatory upstream paid service; optional input producers: SM-SVC-20; authorized equivalent input accepted.
csv.AI agent responsibilities: Financial review; anomaly explanation
csv.Automation operating mode: AI-assisted / supervised; controlled autonomous only for preapproved eligible routine steps; simulation has zero external effects.
csv.Human approval requirements: Approve source/data rights and applicable external actions; approve consequential communications, commitments and changes; routine steps only within preapproved policies.
csv.Related API operations: GET /api/v1/deals/{id}/payments; POST /api/v1/deals/{id}/invoices; POST /api/v1/webhooks/payment; POST /api/v1/deals/{id}/close; GET /api/v1/metrics/revenue; POST /api/v1/admin/kpi-definitions
csv.Related database entities: growth_deal; growth_invoice; growth_payment
csv.Open-source software requirements: Python; Django REST Framework; PostgreSQL; Celery / Beat; Valkey; decimal arithmetic and atomic PostgreSQL transactions
csv.External provider requirements: Authorized accounting/bank/payment connection or statement import; no autonomous money transfer
csv.Estimated execution cost: Illustrative internal text/compute scenario: Cost Model SM-SVC-21-WF04; full execution cost TBD incl. external fees/human/retries.
csv.Subscription pricing model: Proposed monthly base entitlement + metered excess per invoice or receipt record; annual option; provider charges/managed service separately quoted. Price TBD.
csv.Usage limits: Illustrative pilot: 500 invoice or receipt record(s)/month; 1 concurrent run; configurable hard budget, provider quota and frequency limits. Not approved.
csv.Full / partial / selective availability: Full suite / Sales Conversion & Operations bundle / selective (1 SKU); entitlement and usage approval required.
csv.Security and compliance requirements: Tenant + startup scope; capability and entitlement checks per action; minimum data access; audit; budget reservation; idempotency; suppression where applicable. Commercial only; comply with channel, data and advertising permissions; no private fundraising.
csv.Performance KPIs: Duplicate allocations = 0; reconciled payment or exception 100%
csv.Acceptance test references: SM-SVC-21-WF04-AT01; related UI: A073; A074; A082; A083
csv.Implementation and verification status: Proposed; test Not run; live execution and pricing pending.
csv.Independent purchase justification: Standalone outcome: Receivable anomaly and overdue payment-risk monitoring; client may supply equivalent authorized inputs rather than buy upstream services.
csv.Measurable customer outcome: Receivable risk report; accepted against KPI and evidence, not a guaranteed business outcome.
csv.Required service entitlements: SM-SVC-21 + foundation; tenant/startup, capability, role, channel/provider and budget checks at every action
csv.Agent identity and authority: Scoped service principal or authorized delegated user; deny privilege escalation; short-lived grants; no shared credentials
csv.External agent interoperability: Optional authorized connector; external agent access disabled unless explicitly granted
csv.Model portability: Provider-neutral model adapter; rules-first; quality/cost gate; no vendor lock-in assumed
csv.Event and trigger schema: Proposed event envelope: event_id, tenant_id, startup_id, service_id, workflow_revision, input_ref, occurred_at, correlation_id; validate schema and reject mismatched scope
csv.External side-effect classification: Internal analysis/draft; no external action without separate authorization
csv.Idempotency and conflict policy: Idempotency key = scoped event + workflow revision + action target; check duplicate side effects, conflicts, active reply/suppression and budget reservation
csv.Escalation and recovery policy: Bounded retry for safe failures; reconcile uncertain external outcome before retry; pause, route reviewer and log; emergency stop
csv.Data provenance requirements: Authorized source ID, owner, scope, observed_at, evidence hash/version, permitted use, freshness; hold stale/conflicting evidence
csv.Simulation and benchmark reference: SM-SVC-21-WF04-AT01; synthetic dry run and measured benchmark pending
csv.Unit economics and margin target: Unit economics pending actual provider/labor/retry costs; quote subscription + usage; margin target TBD by owner
csv.Technology and regulatory readiness: Proposed; test and validate customer demand, provider access and economics
csv.Service migration and deprecation policy: Stable IDs; version and review material changes; immutable active-run snapshot; no silent downgrade; notify subscribers and map entitlements before migration
